title: Themed events
purpose: Halloween, New Year's Eve and future events as one standard record: date, lights, speakers, checklist and a review after each run.
description: Each event is data. The page shows when it happens next, a checklist, and the review (what worked, what to change). The add-on writes the standard Home Assistant helpers, scripts and automations as text for you to read; it never changes Home Assistant. Halloween is described only (it is live by hand). New Year's Eve is the first event built with the generator.
navigation: Lists events with the next date and open checklist items
Keeps a checklist and a review for each event
Shows the generated Home Assistant files as text
Switches an event's mode only when the option control is live
